content:
Markdown to PDF Converter with Page Break Control Md2Pdf is a free online tool that converts Markdown to PDF with precise page break control. Unlike other converters, you can insert manual page breaks exactly where you want them using a simple ---pagebreak--- marker. See a live, paginated preview before exporting to PDF.
Why Use Md2Pdf? Manual page breaks – Insert ---pagebreak--- anywhere in your Markdown to control exactly where pages split. Live page preview – See your document rendered as real A4 or Letter pages as you type. Mermaid diagrams – Flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and more render directly in your PDF. Print-ready PDF export – One click to export a clean, properly paginated PDF. No signup, no install – Runs entirely in your browser. Your content never leaves your device. How to Add Page Breaks in Markdown Most Markdown to PDF tools give you no control over pagination. Md2Pdf solves this by letting you type ---pagebreak--- on its own line. The converter splits your document at each marker, giving you full control over your printed output.
Supported Features Full Markdown syntax including headings, bold, italic, code blocks, tables, blockquotes, lists, images, and links. Mermaid code blocks are rendered as diagrams. Choose between A4 and Letter paper sizes. Export to PDF via the browser print dialog.
Common Use Cases Creating print-ready documentation from Markdown Generating reports with controlled page layout Converting README files to professional PDFs Producing Mermaid diagram documentation Preparing Markdown lecture notes or handouts for printing

Google Analytics – We use Google Analytics to understand how users interact with our website. Google Analytics may collect data such as your IP address, browser type, operating system, pages visited, and time spent on our site. Google Ads (Future Use) – If we implement Google Ads in the future, cookies may be used to display relevant advertisements. 2. Analytics Cookies – Used by Google Analytics to track website usage. Advertising Cookies (Future Use) – Google Ads may use cookies to deliver targeted advertisements. You can control cookie settings through your browser or opt out of Google Analytics tracking via Google’s opt-out tool.
3. Data Storage and Retention # We do not store personal data on our servers. Any data collected through third-party services is managed by those providers under their respective privacy policies.
4. Third-Party Services # Our website may use the following third-party services:
Google Analytics (Privacy Policy) Google Ads (Future Use) (Privacy Policy) These services may process and store your data independently.
5. Your Rights and Choices # Depending on your location, you may have rights regarding your data, such as:
The right to opt out of tracking and targeted advertising. The ability to manage cookies through browser settings. For more details on how to manage privacy settings, visit Google’s privacy tools.
6. Global Compliance # We strive to comply with international privacy laws, including:
GDPR (for EU users) – As we do not collect personal data directly, compliance is managed via Google services. CCPA (for California users) – Users can manage their data through Google’s privacy settings. 7. Contact Us # If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, you can contact us via our contact form on the website.
